# `tmux-control list`

- **Usage**: `tmux-control list [--socket-name <name>] [--processes]`

Read sessions, window slots, windows, panes and clients

## Flags

### `--socket-name <name>`

Use a named tmux socket (-L)

### `--processes`

Also map clients to terminal OS windows (cgWindowId) and panes to their foreground program
